title: Direct half-prefix matrix inequality
objective: Prove or refute J_ceil(n/2)(A)>=(mu/2)A^{-1}; if false, quantify the determinant-tail correction needed to recover H_ceil(n/2). Use a genuinely averaged matrix-valued argument.
acceptance_checks: Distinguishes J_r from H_r and does not use the determinant leaf silently.
Retains anisotropic child information and reproduces the -28/225 scalar-induction barrier.
Uses full random-prefix averaging rather than a pathwise complement or reversal lemma.
Any positive conclusion controls expectation of distance, not only distance of the expected iterate.
